title: Install available firmware updates
summary: Apply the firmware updates that were previously detected. This may require a reboot to take effect.

steps.explain: Install the firmware updates that were previously detected.

warnings: Do not interrupt the update process or power off the computer while it is running, as this can damage your hardware.
A reboot is usually required after the update completes.

rollback.explain: There is no direct command to revert firmware updates. If the update fails or causes issues, you may need to re-flash the previous firmware version using the manufacturer's tools.
